node.statement: It is enough to prove the pointwise row bound E_r^j(i) <= E_r(i) + max(R_{r,j}(i),0) for every row index i: multiplying by w_i=max(beta_r(i),0) >= 0 and summing over the finite row set gives Phi_r(V_j) <= Phi_r(U)+I_{r,j}(U) by the definitions of Phi_r(V_j), Phi_r(U), and I_{r,j}(U).
